rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:15 as water in the base tray, ruled out filter and foam, and ended by recommending an engineer without naming a part to buy. Weaknesses: it asked the customer to remove the plinth after they had already said it was a glued kitchen plinth (the customer had mentioned the gap only after turn 1), and the drain hose check was marginal given the tray water. It also never advised turning off the water supply. The final turn's claim that the machine 'will remain locked out' is somewhat overstated, but the isolation advice and escalation were appropriate.
